summary: Breaking: MigrationManager.Rollback(ctx, steps) rolls back exactly the requested number of applied migrations (error if fewer are applied) and `migrate down` defaults to one; rolling back every migration now requires RollbackAll or `migrate down --all`. Rollbacks only touch applied migrations, never pending Up SQL. Run takes a context. Migrations run on one session holding a Postgres advisory lock, so concurrent replicas apply each migration once; statements get a default 30s lock_timeout (WithMigrationLockTimeout), and `-- +migrate Up/Down notransaction` migrations run outside a transaction.
